title: Divorce petition 15 June: three months of reconciliation attempts end on 15 September

expect.why: Text: «يجب ألا تتجاوز محاولات الصلح ثلاثة (3) أشهر من تاريخ رفع دعوى الطلاق» (same in [family-code 49 ¶1]: «ابتداء من تاريخ رفع الدعوى»). Three months from 2026-06-15 reach 2026-09-15 if the starting day is not counted and the period is complete at the end of the same-numbered day. The texts given contain no counting rule (whether the filing day counts, whether the last day is included), so the text does not settle this. Other readings: 2026-09-14 (filing day counts) and 2026-09-16 (neither first nor last day counts). The limit binds the court's attempts, not the lawyer's petition; no slot holds the date of the last attempt.

title: Divorce petition 31 August: month-end start, November has only 30 days

expect.why: Text: «ثلاثة (3) أشهر من تاريخ رفع دعوى الطلاق». Starting on 31 August, three months fall in November, which has no 31st; the more likely reading is the month's last day, 2026-11-30 (a Monday). The text does not say what to do when the month is shorter, nor how to count the starting day: the text does not settle this. Other last days: 2026-11-29 (filing day counts) or 2026-12-01 (the overflow into the next month, or neither first nor last day counted).

title: Divorce petition 30 November: three months end in February 2027 (28 days)

expect.why: Text: «ثلاثة (3) أشهر من تاريخ رفع دعوى الطلاق». 30 November plus three months lands on 30 February, which does not exist in 2027 (not a leap year); more likely reading: the month's last day, 2027-02-28 (a Sunday). The texts do not say how to count: the text does not settle this. Other last days: 2027-02-27 (filing day counts) and 2027-03-01 or 2027-03-02 (overflow or first and last day excluded).

title: Divorce petition 29 May: three months end on Saturday 29 August

expect.why: Text: «ثلاثة (3) أشهر من تاريخ رفع دعوى الطلاق». 2026-05-29 plus three months is 2026-08-29, a Saturday. The texts given do not say which days are weekly rest days or holidays, nor whether a period ending on such a day runs to the next working day: the text does not settle this. Last day under the more likely reading (no extension): 2026-08-29; if extended to the next working day: 2026-08-30 (Sunday, if Friday and Saturday are the rest days, which these texts do not state).

title: Divorce petition 5 April: three months end on 5 July, an official holiday

expect.why: Text: «ثلاثة (3) أشهر من تاريخ رفع دعوى الطلاق». 2026-04-05 plus three months is 2026-07-05, a Sunday and, by general knowledge, a national holiday. The texts given do not list official holidays nor extend periods ending on one: the text does not settle this. Last day 2026-07-05 under the more likely reading; 2026-07-06 if the period runs to the next working day.

title: Specialised commercial court: non-conciliation record delivered and attached

expect.why: Text: «في حالة فشل محاولة الصلح، ترفع الدعوى ... مرفقة، تحت طائلة عدم قبول الدعوى شكلا، بمحضر عدم الصلح». The record exists and predates the petition, so the prior step is done. The slot wording speaks of the conciliation office; it is read here as the record of the conciliation judge under [cpca 536 مكرر 4 ¶1].

title: Specialised commercial court: no conciliation record, no exemption in the text

expect.why: Text: «يسبق قيد الدعوى إجراء الصلح» and the petition must be attached «تحت طائلة عدم قبول الدعوى شكلا، بمحضر عدم الصلح». The step was not taken; the text gives no exemption for any of the matters of [cpca 536 مكرر ¶1 to ¶7].

title: Specialised commercial court: whether a record exists is unknown

expect.why: The text requires the non-conciliation record to be attached on pain of inadmissibility; whether it was drawn up is not known, so the rule must ask, not assume no.

title: Specialised commercial court: conciliation ended in an agreement, no non-conciliation record

expect.why: Text: [cpca 536 مكرر 4 ¶3] speaks only of the case where the attempt fails and requires «محضر عدم الصلح»; [cpca 536 مكرر 4 ¶2] says conciliation ends with a record signed by the judge, the parties and the clerk, and [cpca 993 ¶1] makes a conciliation record an enforceable title. The texts do not say what is required when the agreement covers only part of the dispute, or whether a petition on the rest needs a non-conciliation record: the text does not settle this; the rule must warn, not decide.

title: Specialised commercial court: two non-conciliation records for the same dispute

expect.why: Text: the petition is attached to «محضر عدم الصلح»; a record exists, and the text names no time limit running from its delivery and says nothing of an earlier record, so the later record (2026-05-20) does not change the answer. The nearby date of the earlier record (2026-03-02) would give the same outcome.

title: Ordinary commercial dispute outside the specialised court: no prior conciliation required

expect.why: Text: the conciliation that precedes filing and the record attached are laid down in the section on «المحكمة التجارية المتخصصة», whose subjects are listed in [cpca 536 مكرر ¶2 to ¶7]. A commercial dispute that is none of them stays in the ordinary commercial section, and the text imposes no prior conciliation there. Outcome vocabulary has no value for 'step not applicable'; stepExempt is the nearest.

title: Bank claim against a non-trader: just outside the specialised court

expect.why: Text: «منازعات البنوك والمؤسسات المالية مع التجار». A dispute of a bank with a person who is not a trader is outside that paragraph, so the specialised court and its prior conciliation do not apply. The case is assumed to concern a bank and a non-trader (that fact has no slot; it is shown by specialised_commercial_subject = no).

title: Bank claim against a trader: leaves the ordinary courts for the specialised commercial court

expect.why: Text: «تختص المحكمة التجارية المتخصصة بالنظر في المنازعات المذكورة أدناه : ... – منازعات البنوك والمؤسسات المالية مع التجار».

title: Whether the dispute is one of the specialised court's subjects is unknown

expect.why: Whether the specialised court hears the dispute decides both the court and the prior conciliation; with the fact unknown the rule must ask, not default to the ordinary court.

title: Divorce petition: reconciliation attempts are the judge's, after filing, not a prior step

expect.why: Text: «محاولات الصلح وجوبية، وتتم في جلسة سرية» and «يجريها القاضي» ([family-code 49 ¶1]); the attempts are made by the judge «من تاريخ رفع الدعوى», so nothing is required of the lawyer before filing and no clean-export blocker can rest on their absence. No slot holds whether attempts were held; the outcome vocabulary has no value for 'not a prior step', so stepExempt is used.

title: Khul petition: do the compulsory reconciliation attempts apply?

expect.why: Text: [cpca 439 ¶1] «محاولات الصلح وجوبية» sits in the section on divorce procedure; [cpca 451 ¶5] names khul in that same section, and [family-code 57 ¶1] groups «الطلاق والتطليق والخلع»; but [family-code 49 ¶1] says «لا يثبت الطلاق إلا بحكم بعد عدة محاولات صلح» and [family-code 54] on khul does not mention attempts. The texts do not say whether khul is covered: the text does not settle this; the rule must warn, not decide.

title: Custody-only petition by a family court: mediation excluded

expect.why: Text: «يجب على القاضي عرض إجراء الوساطة على الخصوم في جميع المواد، باستثناء قضايا شؤون الأسرة والقضايا العمالية». A family matter is excluded, and mediation is in any case offered by the judge during the proceedings, not required of the lawyer before filing. stepExempt is the nearest value for 'no prior mediation step'.

title: Wage claim by a worker: mediation excluded for labour cases

expect.why: Text: «باستثناء قضايا شؤون الأسرة والقضايا العمالية». A labour case is excluded from the judge's duty to offer mediation. The texts given do not include any labour conciliation step, so nothing is concluded about it here.

title: Ordinary civil debt claim: mediation is offered by the judge after filing, not a prior step

expect.why: Text: «يجب على القاضي عرض إجراء الوساطة على الخصوم»: the duty is the judge's and arises in the proceedings, and [cpca 994 ¶2] makes the mediation depend on the parties' acceptance. No step is required before filing. Whether the matter touches public order (the other exclusion in ¶1) has no slot; assumed not.

title: Family case with the family slot unknown: is mediation excluded?

expect.why: Text: mediation is excluded for «قضايا شؤون الأسرة»; whether the dispute is a family matter is not known, so the rule must ask rather than assume it is not.
